name: comprehension-gate
description: Have the coding agent leave a docstring and an immutable note for each change, and show it the notes before it edits

interface.shortDescription: Record what each change was for, and read it before the next.
interface.longDescription: Comprehension Gate asks the coding agent to leave a docstring on what it changed and an immutable note on what the change was for, derives the branch's change set from git to say which paths still have no note, and names a path's notes before the agent reads or edits it. It never blocks a tool or holds a turn.
interface.defaultPrompt: List the changed paths on this branch that no note records yet, then write the missing docstrings and notes.
